_comment: Max hardcoded color literals per file. Generated by tests/update-color-budget.js. A budget may only ever go DOWN — the ratchet in the test suite enforces it. Palette definitions in app.css theme scopes are excluded by the counter. The one exception is --rebaseline "reason", which is logged in _rebaselines below.

_rebaselines.reason: Counter fixed in v0.9.1293: the old regex comment-stripper read accept="image/*" inside a string as a comment opener and blanked the rest of the file. These literals were always in the app; they were never counted. wizard.js was being read at 4% of its real size.

request #19 picker rows add a variation line and section tag to the always-dark scanner overlay, which renders theme-independent literals by design (+3 in barcode.js, reusing the overlay's existing palette values)
v0.9.1302: sell.js +1 — the copy-for-email stitch fills its canvas seams #ffffff because the picture lands in an email body, which is white; print-side, not themeable

v0.9.1303: tools.js +10 — the Shared Photos card and its Stop sharing / Stop sharing all buttons use the same per-card accent-literal pattern as every other tools card in this file (orange #e67e22 for the card, red #e74c3c for stop-all)

v0.9.1312: tools.js +12 — the one-time Vault Cleanup card follows the file's per-card accent-literal pattern (red #e74c3c card/run-button trio + white, and the shared green/red status blocks other tools cards already use); the card removes itself after the cleanup runs

v0.9.1338: tools.js +8 — the Master Fix-Up one-time card follows the same per-card destructive-red literal pattern as Vault Cleanup: #e74c3c is deliberately literal in button styles because app.css's destructive-button lever (button[style*=#e74c3c]) keys on that exact string

v0.9.1345: tools.js +8 — the Master Fix-Up 1.73 card is the fourth one-time tool in this file and wears the identical destructive-red literal pattern as Vault Cleanup, Master Fix-Up 1.72 and Version Tidy; #e74c3c stays literal because app.css's destructive-button lever selects on style*=#e74c3c

v0.9.1416: tools.js +19 — Master Fix-Up 1.74 (v0.9.1346) and 1.75 (v0.9.1347) shipped without moving the budget, leaving the ratchet red on main. Every one of the 19 is the same destructive-red literal the previous four rebaselines logged: 17x #e74c3c plus 2x rgb(231,76,60). #e74c3c stays literal because app.css's destructive-button lever selects on style*="#e74c3c" — pointing it at a custom property would silently unstyle the button.
